recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit commit. If PA wants more specific Encounter.class concepts in the future, handle that through a terminology/UTG update and change the core binding only if the canonical value set target changes.
issue_request: FHIR-32341 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked PA to resolve Encounter.class hierarchy/value-set ambiguity by making Encounter.class 0..* CodeableConcept, using a Preferred binding, and creating a smaller Encounter class value set with inpatient, outpatient, observation, emergency, virtual, and community-style base concepts from v3 ActEncounterCode.
initial_application: The source change was applied before this reconciliation: FHIR-32342 changed Encounter.class to CodeableConcept, 868cd2a065 changed Encounter.class from 1..1 to 0..* and the binding from extensible to preferred, bf06a893cc moved the binding to the new THO EncounterClass value set, and 7445c2b58a later fixed the canonical URL to http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/encounter-class.
additional_context: Encounter is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml currently defines Encounter.class as 0..* CodeableConcept with a preferred binding to http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/encounter-class. The local THO package for that value set includes v3 ActCode concepts IMP, AMB, OBSENC, EMER, VR, and HH. UP-344 records the terminology-side implementation, FHIR-32974 was closed as a duplicate after FHIR-32341 was accepted, FHIR-39147 fixed the value set URL, and later PA minutes describe the 0..* relaxed solution as intentional.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current authoritative core source already reflects the final FHIR-32341 decision, and the remaining value set content is maintained in THO/UTG rather than in a FHIR core source file.
